title: Canonical filesystem repository: store, lock, and atomic writes
objective: A typed canonical filesystem adapter reads and writes workspace documents with ADR 0005 serialization, ADR 0006 locking and staged atomic replacement, path-boundary enforcement, and a user-level context registry — all consumable as application APIs by later packages.
business_value: WP-300 transactions, WP-210 rebuilds, and every mutation workflow depend on one safe, deterministic canonical store; today writes are ad-hoc and unlocked.
scope: Implement src/workctx/adapters/filesystem/serialization.py: the ADR 0005 canonical emitter (exact pinned PyYAML parameters, declaration-order keys, ADR 0009 null-vs-omit rule) and canonical Markdown+frontmatter rendering using workctx.domain.frontmatter for the read side; include the hand-edit detection primitive from ADR 0005 (byte comparison against canonical re-serialization)

Implement src/workctx/adapters/filesystem/store.py: CanonicalStore bound to a resolved context root — typed read/write of workspace documents (context config, entity frontmatter, tasks, artifact manifests via the domain models), directory-zone awareness, and path-boundary enforcement (resolve and compare canonical paths, reject .. escape and symlink/reparse escape per 08-security-and-privacy.md)

Implement src/workctx/adapters/filesystem/lock.py: the full ADR 0006 lock protocol — O_EXCL create with nonce identity, atomic heartbeat refresh preserving nonce, stale detection (pid, heartbeat threshold, unparseable-lock mtime rule), observable takeover via lock.stale-<timestamp>.json rename, and fence verification helper

Implement src/workctx/adapters/filesystem/staging.py: staged multi-file atomic replacement — same-volume staging under 98_state/staging/, fsync, write-ahead intent record (intent.json with transaction id, nonce, ordered targets, content hashes) before the first os.replace, bounded exponential-backoff retry on Windows PermissionError, and recovery inspection API that reports partially applied intent records

Implement the user-level context registry (doc-04 resolution step 3): platformdirs-based user registry mapping context ids to roots, with list/register/unregister APIs in src/workctx/adapters/filesystem/registry.py; do NOT wire it into the CLI presentation layer (lead integrates)
Route _write_context_config in src/workctx/services/contexts.py through the new canonical serializer without changing the four frozen public signatures
Document the runtime 98_state layout you own: lock.json, staging/**, backups/ naming (docs/reference/canonical-store.md)
non_goals: No transaction proposals, preconditions, audit events, or ledger writes (WP-300; ADR 0010 semantics land there)
No SQLite files or projections (WP-210 owns 98_state/index.sqlite3)
No CLI commands or presentation changes; the registry is API-only this wave (lead wires resolution step 3 at integration)
No new runtime dependencies (platformdirs and PyYAML are already runtime deps); needing one is a stop condition
deliverables: Filesystem adapter package: serialization, store, lock, staging, registry — with full unit and integration tests
services/contexts.py writing through the canonical serializer, signatures unchanged
acceptance_criteria: Canonical serialization is byte-deterministic: serializing the same logical document twice, and re-serializing a parsed document, produce identical bytes; golden-file test pins the format
Lock protocol passes contention, stale-takeover, fence-abort, torn-heartbeat, and unparseable-lock tests using plain files and simulated second holders

Staged replacement: an injected failure between replaces leaves the intent record and staged files; the recovery API reports exactly which targets are partially applied; retry policy triggers on injected PermissionError and gives up with a recoverable error after the bounded attempts
Path-boundary enforcement rejects .. traversal and symlink/junction escape in tests (junction test may be skipped with a recorded reason when the CI user lacks privileges)
Registry APIs are idempotent and never store machine-absolute paths inside workspace files (registry lives in the user config dir, not the context)

Existing context init/inspect/validate behavior and all existing tests pass unchanged; context.yaml output remains byte-compatible or the change is proven canonical per ADR 0005 and covered by an updated golden test
security_constraints: No secrets in fixtures; no network; symlink/junction handling must fail closed
Lock and staging files stay inside 98_state/ of the target context only
stop_conditions: Any needed change to frozen files, the four public service signatures, or pyproject.toml
Discovery that ADR 0005/0006 semantics cannot be implemented as specified on a supported platform
Any need to define transaction or audit semantics (WP-300 territory)
